content.text: Follow the games, bounce by bounce, with the round-by-round schedule By Christopher Cason | Published 10:00 AM EST Mar 23, 2026 Icon Sportswire via Getty Images So, how’s your bracket holding up? You can get the up-to-date 2026 March Madness® schedule here, now complete with the NCAA Division I Men’s Basketball Tournament games of the Sweet 16 round. You can watch the games on CBS and Turner networks (TBS, TNT, and truTV). CBS Sports will present marquee matchups all the way up to the Elite Eight®. For streaming viewers, Paramount+ offers live access to CBS games to subscribers with the Paramount+ Premium plan. Read on for the full 2026 March Madness® schedule. Channel: CBS Streaming: Paramount+ (Paramount+ Premium plan only) Teams: 2 Iowa State vs. 6 Tennessee Time: 10:10 PM ET Region: Midwest Location: United Center (Chicago, Illinois) Channel: TBS Elite Eight® Dates: March 28-29, 2026 Final Four® Date: Saturday, April 4, 2026 National Championship Date: Monday, April 6, 2026 What to know about the March Madness® schedule Each stage of the March Madness® schedule narrows the field: the First and Second Rounds reduce the tourney’s 64 teams to 16; the Sweet 16 and Elite Eight® rounds determine the Final Four® participants; the Final Four® games determine the two teams that’ll compete in the National Championship game. How to watch and stream March Madness® 2026 March Madness® games air across multiple broadcast partners, including CBS. Watching on TV Select games from the First Round to Elite Eight® air live on CBS. Streaming Options If you’re looking to stream March Madness® live, keep in mind that Paramount+ subscribers with the Paramount+ Premium plan can stream the CBS games live. To stream CBS games live via Paramount+: Sign up for Paramount+. (CC required. T&C apply.) Select the Premium plan for live CBS access. Visit the Paramount+ Help Center for details on plans and pricing. Navigate to the Live TV section during scheduled games. For more info, get our guide to watching and streaming March Madness®. When is the Final Four® 2026? The men’s Final Four® takes place on Saturday, April 4, 2026, at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana. TBS will broadcast the games, two in all. The semifinal contests determine which schools advance to the championship. When is the 2026 National Championship Game? The men’s National Championship Game will be played at 8:30 PM ET, on Monday, April 6, 2026, at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana. TBS will broadcast the game. This game decides the NCAA Division I Men’s Basketball champion. By this stage, the bracket has been reduced from 68 total teams to two, and every possession carries championship weight. Where is the Final Four® 2026 being played? The Final Four® is being played at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana, on Saturday, April 4, 2026. Indianapolis has long been associated with college basketball history, making it a fitting host city for championship weekend. The venue will host the two national semifinal games (aka the Final Four®) on Saturday, April 4, 2026, and the National Championship on Monday, April 6, 2026. When did March Madness® 2026 start? March Madness® games started March 17-March 18, 2026, with the first First Four play-in games. After, the bracket’s final 64 spots were set, and the free-for-all began with First Round action on March 19-March 20, 2026. When is March Madness®? March Madness® is the name for the season-ending, NCAA Division I basketball tournament. Every March, the tournament transforms college hoops into a national spectacle, where buzzer beaters become instant classics, and underdogs rewrite the bracket in real time. From the First Four to the Final Four®, every possession carries championship weight. Before it’s over, a total of 67 games will be played by 68 teams. Get Started With Paramount+
